# KLASIK CAFE Workspace Instructions

- Read `PROJECT_NOTES.md` at the start of work on this project and treat it as the durable handoff for future chat sessions.
- Keep `PROJECT_NOTES.md` current whenever implementation, scope, behavior, decisions, or validation status changes. Update it in the same session as the project change, including a concise note about checks run and remaining work when relevant.
- This project is a beginner-friendly ELEC 3 café website. Use only semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript unless the project owner explicitly changes that constraint.
- Keep the first-version scope to the homepage, login page, and sign-up page. Do not add backend services, real authentication, ordering, payment, dashboards, or database features unless explicitly requested.
- Preserve the shared KLASIK CAFE Royal Blue visual identity and responsive behavior across all three pages.
